profile.headline: IT at Education
profile.summary:
IT support specialist with several years of experience in supporting and analyzing the needs and
designing solutions for IT projects. An ambitious, self-motivated individual able to work well as part of a team or individually using own initiative when required to complete tasks and meet targets within the set time frames. A friendly, helpful and polite individual who is always willing to listen and learn new skills, have a flexible approach to juggling many different priorities and can communicate effectively at all levels both written and orally. Has excellent organizational skills including attention to detail

Front-end web skills:
Expertise in Angular, C#, ASP.NET, VB.NET, HTML, HTML5 JavaScript, CSS, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, Web API, and Bootstrap

Back-end web skills:
Object-oriented programming. Proficiency in C#, Model View Controller (MVC) architecture, Razor, Dependency Injection, and Visual Studio.

Database skills:
Proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server and Transact-SQL. Knowledge of the rules of database normalization. Ability to design a well-structured relational database multiple related tables. Ability to write, insert, update, and delete statements as well as stored procedures, functions, and complex queries that join several tables. Knowledge of database indexes as well as experience in using indexes to increase query performance.
